A ritual book of the Serbian Orthodox Church in Old Serbian Cyrillic, printed in the printing shop of the serb Crnojevič rulers in Cetinje. The copy is from the collection of the Slovene linguist Jernej Kopitar.
NUK keeps two specimens of this well-known, lavishly illustrated historical chronicles, describing also the Counts of Celje and the regions of Istria, Carniola and Styria.
The codex is decorated with 12 initials in blue, green, pink, red, violet and ochre.
